GenAiPlugin.description: Invocable actions for the Production domain: production history, well status transitions, and royalty calculations.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Use Get Production History to report a well's production volumes/allocations (default look-back 12 months). Use Calculate Royalty to compute royalty and revenue shares for a lease. The Transition Well Status is a WRITE action: always confirm the proposed status change with the user before executing, and only after confirming.
